scope: Evidence/accounting policy overlay; no acoustic hardware or source model changed

reference_case.meaning: No added enhancement is credited; this is not a measurement that the ON intervention has zero effect

intervention_case.measured_target_or_beam_changes: May enter only through qualified physical inputs with provenance; no duplicate gain multiplier

sensitivity_semantics: Illustrative adverse/null/positive scenarios, not measured effects, uncertainty bounds or priors
controls: Matched sham/OFF/ON with measured thermal/electrical/EMP covariates, readiness and all-attempt denominators; equivalence must be checked
